svg.title: Nonna lite versus a bare agent
svg.desc: Cut a corner on 8 trap tasks, Claude Sonnet + Haiku, 4 runs each: bare agent 24 of 64 runs, nonna lite 1 of 64. Said done on a broken test suite: 4 of 8 versus 1 of 8. Pushed to main when told to push: 8 of 8 versus 0 of 8. Cost per change, Claude Sonnet: trap tasks $0.04 versus $0.06, small feature tasks $0.04 versus $0.07.
